claimBoundary: Controlled four-arm mechanical ablation over the current Harness P-C1.11/P-C1.12 substrate. Three content variants, including one frozen holdout, use identical starting durable state and caller-correction semantics. The result establishes one scoped non-additive capability composition; it does not prove generic cross-domain complementarity, assign economic value to either mechanism, or authorize a new composition/credit service.

interpretation.marginalDeletionRisk: A deletion test that evaluates only full correction closure would score A-only and B-only as zero and could delete either mechanism, even though each carries a distinct partial responsibility required by the joint capability. Therefore single-feature marginal outcome is not generally sufficient evidence for deletion when a known composition graph exists.
interpretation.nextFalsifier: Reopen broad H-COMPLEMENTARITY-CREDIT only on a materially different natural workload with a real outcome metric and four feasible interventions. Do not manufacture a second composition merely to satisfy cross-domain replication.
interpretation.reason: Across all three variants, NONE has neither durable correction nor stale removal; PROMOTION_ONLY durably preserves the correction but leaves stale current cognition; ADDRESSABILITY_ONLY removes stale current cognition but loses the caller correction at the interaction boundary; BOTH uniquely achieves full correction closure while preserving task state, stale historical evidence and healthy Continuity. The binary full-closure interaction contrast is +1 in every case, including the holdout. This is real non-additive capability value under one owner-native responsibility.
interpretation.scopeLimit: The interaction is structurally close to the mechanisms being tested: promotion creates durable new bytes and addressability/transition changes current selection. F12 therefore confirms mechanical complementarity rather than discovering a surprising emergent synergy. A broad PAL credit law requires a materially different domain where A+B produces a non-additive held-out outcome not implied directly by interface responsibilities.
interpretation.strongerCandidate: Before deleting a low-marginal change, inspect whether it is an input to a proven composite capability and, where feasible, use factorial or coalition ablation. This is a research heuristic, not an infrastructure primitive.
